title: EmeraldVillagerLure
body:
# EmeraldVillagerLure
Required Plugin: https://modrinth.com/plugin/kotlinplugins
- Allows the players to attract villagers by holding Emerald/EmeraldBlock in main-hand or off-hand.

- Holding Emerald attracts all villagers from the range of 10 blocks.
- Holding Emerald Block attracts all villagers from the range of 20 blocks.
- Attracted Villagers will follow you, look in your direction and teleport in case you are too far.
- The purpose of this plugin is to simplify the process of getting villagers but also to introduce new mechanics like villager stealing, villager mind-attack, express villagers greed.
- Check out other plugins: https://modrinth.com/user/Winlyps
